name: Illegal Logging and Timber Trafficking
description: Harvesting, transport or trade of timber in breach of national law or concession rules, including logging in protected areas and mislabelled species or origin. Proceeds often pass through timber traders, export companies and shipping firms, with laundered volumes blended into legal supply.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering from Environmental Crime (2021)
UNEP and INTERPOL, The Rise of Environmental Crime: A Growing Threat to Natural Resources, Peace, Development and Security (2016)
OECD, Due Diligence Guidance for Responsible Business Conduct (2018)

exposure.rationale: Timber exporters and traders; cash to informal suppliers, trade documents and payments to officials for permits.

indicators.name: Timber exports exceeding documented concession capacity
indicators.canon: Volumes exceed documented production or capacity
indicators.desc: Exports or output reported exceed documented production, concession or capacity limits.
indicators.ctx: Export volumes from a client are higher than its licensed harvest area could plausibly yield.
indicators.fp: Stocks and purchases from other licensed sources may explain.

indicators.name: Species or origin descriptions inconsistent across documents
indicators.canon: Trade documents inconsistent with each other
indicators.desc: Bill of lading, invoice, customs, letter of credit or payment details disagree on goods, quantity, price, origin, parties or route.
indicators.ctx: Shipping, customs and invoices mention different species, origin or volumes.
indicators.fp: Descriptions of mixed woods often vary.

indicators.name: Origin country is a transit-only processor with no forests
indicators.canon: Origin country is a transit-only processor with no forests
indicators.desc: Exports declared from a country with little domestic timber supply, indicating laundering of origin.
indicators.ctx: Exports declared from a country with little domestic timber supply, indicating laundering of origin.
indicators.fp: Processing hubs import and re-export timber lawfully.

indicators.name: Cash payments to local loggers and chain-saw operators
indicators.canon: Cash payments to informal suppliers or ground-level operators
indicators.desc: Large or repeated cash payments to informal traders, producers or workers in extraction or supply chains.
indicators.ctx: Large cash withdrawals followed by purchases of raw logs from informal suppliers.
indicators.fp: Informal logging is lawful in some community forestry.

indicators.name: Shell exporters opened for short period with identical directors
indicators.canon: Short-lived or rotating entities with common controllers
indicators.desc: Entities are repeatedly formed, abandoned or replaced by successors sharing directors, addresses or history of prior defaulted companies.
indicators.ctx: Several short-lived timber exporters share directors, addresses and bank signatories.

indicators.name: Payments to officials for permits or to bypass inspections
indicators.canon: Payments to public officials to obtain permits or bypass controls
indicators.desc: Payments are made to officials, rangers or couriers around licences, inspections, reserves, ports or border clearances.
indicators.ctx: Payments to forestry or customs officials linked to licences or clearances.
indicators.fp: Fees and official services are lawfully paid.

indicators.name: Operation in or adjacent to protected areas or indigenous lands
indicators.canon: Operation in or adjacent to protected areas or indigenous lands
indicators.desc: Customer's supply is sourced from areas with legal restrictions or conflicts reported.
indicators.ctx: Customer's supply is sourced from areas with legal restrictions or conflicts reported.

indicators.name: Adverse media on illegal logging or enforcement notices
indicators.canon: Adverse media on customer or associates
indicators.desc: Credible negative news, enforcement notices or investigations link the customer, its owners or associates to criminal, corrupt or regulated-sector misconduct.
indicators.ctx: Customer is named in seizure, sanction or investigation news.
